title: Longest Palindrome Inside
statement:
A **palindrome** reads the same forwards and backwards. Given `text`, look at every stretch of consecutive letters inside it.

Return the **length of the longest stretch that is a palindrome**.
constraints: text contains only lowercase letters a-z

examples.explanation: bab (or aba) reads the same both ways.

hints.nudge: Every palindrome has a centre. Where can the centre be?
hints.pattern: Expand around each centre (one letter, or the gap between two letters).
hints.pseudocode:
best = 1
for each centre c (n letters and n-1 gaps):
  expand left and right while the letters match
  best = max(best, length of that palindrome)
return best
hints.walkthrough: Checking every substring costs O(n^3) (O(n^2) substrings, O(n) check each). Instead, a palindrome grows outward from its centre: for each of the 2n-1 possible centres (a letter for odd lengths, a gap between letters for even lengths), keep expanding while the two end letters are equal. Each expansion is at most O(n), so O(n^2) overall with O(1) space.
